research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: www.danamon.co.id HTML pages answer this server with an F5 'Request Rejected' page, but the PDF files under /-/media/ download directly (HTTP 200, application/pdf); no challenge was bypassed. The IR listing pages (Financial Information, Annual Reports, RUPS, Corporate Presentation) were read from Internet Archive snapshots to find the document URLs (timestamps in sources.md). The 1Q26/1H26/9M26 analyst decks are not linked in any archived page; their URLs were found by following the site's own naming pattern (ANALYST-BRIEFING/2026/Q1|Q2|Q3/...).

CONSOLIDATION SCOPE (read before comparing years): consolidated = the Bank + PT Adira Dinamika Multi Finance (Adira/ADMF; 92.07% until 30 Sep 2025, 74.50% after Mandala Multifinance (MFIN) was merged into Adira on 1 Oct 2025) + from 24 Jun 2026 PT Home Credit Indonesia (HCI; 9.82% direct stake bought from Adira for Rp400bn plus control under a shareholders' agreement with Krungsri, so HCI is consolidated with large non-controlling interests). MFIN and HCI were under MUFG common control, so both were accounted for as business combinations under common control (PSAK 338): AR2025 restated FY2024 as if MFIN had always been in the group, and the 1H2026 FS / 1H26 and 9M26 decks restate FY2025, 1H25 and 9M25 again for HCI. Bank-only figures are never used for money values.

AS ORIGINALLY REPORTED: every fy.* level, profit and EPS is taken from that year's own audited FS (inside that year's annual report). Restated values are given in the datum notes: FY2020 and FY2021 (AR2022, PSAK 24 employee-benefit attribution guidance - small), FY2024 (AR2025, MFIN: total assets 247,967.392; equity attributable 53,315.590; total equity 54,818.844; profit 3,482.828; EPS 356.35; loans gross 192,032; deposits 150,467.727) and FY2025 (1H2026 FS, HCI: total assets 281,738.999; equity attributable 54,214.369; total equity 61,173.202). Growth FY2024->FY2025 computed from these levels mixes the pre-MFIN FY2024 with the post-MFIN FY2025 (AR2025 reports loans +9.8% on the restated base; from the stored levels it is +13.5%).

LOANS: fy.*.loans_gross is the AR Financial Highlights line 'Loans - Gross' (footnote a: loans + consumer financing receivables + finance lease receivables of Adira Finance), printed in Rp bn - the group 'total loans' the bank reports, not summed by us. The FS line 'Loans' alone (Note 11, gross, excl. consumer financing and lease receivables) is smaller: Rp173.8tn at end-2025 (AR2025 MD&A PDF p. 129). The interim uses the deck's wider 'Total Lending' (incl. marketable securities, trade finance and ijarah assets).

DEPOSITS: fy.*.deposits = FS Note 21 'Deposits from customers' total. The AR highlight line 'Deposits from customers & other banks' and the deck 'Funding' (CASA + TD, management basis: 176.9tn vs Note 21 174.2tn at Dec-25) are not the same thing; the interim uses the deck 'Funding' because no 9M26 statement was found.

RATIO BASIS: taken from each year's own AR. MD&A 'Key Financial Ratios' table labels: CAR, gross NPL, ROA (after tax), ROE, NIM = consolidated; LDR and Cost to Income = bank only. From the Financial Highlights ratio table: npl_net and Loan Loss Coverage (consolidated - AR2025 footnote g marks only CIR, BOPO, LDR and CASA as bank only), BOPO and CASA (bank only; labelled only in AR2025). CoC and LAR come from each year's FY analyst deck (consolidated; LAR = NPL + SM + restructured coll. 1 incl. COVID restructured loans under forbearance).

RATIO CONFLICTS a reviewer may want to see: AR2024 prints NIM 2024 as 7.0 (highlights) and 7.3 (MD&A, stored); AR2025's MD&A text says NIM 7.8% while its tables say 7.4 (stored); the decks use another NIM definition (FY25 7.7, FY23 8.2 vs AR 7.4 and 7.7). AR2025 prints 2024 CIR as 55.8 and 54.9 vs 54.1 in AR2024, and its 'bank-only' FY2025 CIR (55.3) equals the deck's consolidated CIR - the bank-only label may be wrong. AR2025 prints 2024 BOPO 81.6 vs 79.9 in AR2024. Small highlight/MD&A differences: CIR 2020 46.3/46.5, CIR 2022 50.1/50.0, LDR 2023 96.6/96.5, ROE 2020 2.6/2.7. All are noted on the datums; no value was changed.

LOW-PROFIT YEARS: FY2020 (profit 1,007.6, ROE 2.7%) and FY2021 (1,573.1, ROE 4.1%) were hit by COVID provisioning (CoC 4.7% and 4.4%); no loss year. FY2020 LDR 84.0% and RIM 85.0% are real (loan book shrank).

DIVIDENDS: exactly one final cash dividend per fiscal year, 35% of net profit attributable, FY2020-FY2025; no interim or special dividends (each statement of changes in equity shows one distribution a year). The FY2019 dividend (45%, Rp187.55/share, paid 24 Apr 2020) is outside the FY2020-FY2025 scope. dividend.total = amount actually distributed per FS Note 32 (the notices print an approximate amount). No FY2026 interim dividend was found in any document (1H2026 FS, 9M26 deck) as of 2026-11-03. Danamon has two share series (A and B) that receive the same DPS.

CORPORATE ACTIONS: none of type split / reverse split / rights / bonus since 2019-01-01 (AR2025 PDF pp. 90-91 share listing chronology; the last rights issue was 2011, the last reverse split 2003). The only change in share count: 188,909,505 B-series shares issued for the merger with PT Bank Nusantara Parahyangan Tbk, effective 1 May 2019 (AR2025 PDF p. 593, Note 1) (9,584,643,365 -> 9,773,552,870 shares) - a merger issue, not a rights or bonus issue, so it is not recorded in corporate_actions. No treasury shares at the parent level in any year.
